title: PySpark Autoloader: How to enforce schema and fail on mismatch?
question:
Hi all I am using Databricks Autoloader with PySpark to ingest Parquet files from a directory. Here's a simplified version of my current setup:

spark.readStream \
.format("cloudFiles") \
.option("cloudFiles.format", "parquet") \
.load("path") \
.writeStream \
.format("delta") \
.outputMode("append") \
.toTable("tablename")

I want to explicitly enforce an expected schema and fail fast if any new files do not match this schema. I know that .readStream(...).schema(expected_schema) is available, but it appears to perform implicit type casting rather than strictly validating the schema. I have also heard of workarounds like defining a table or DataFrame with the desired schema and comparing but that feels clunky as if I am doing something wrong. Is there a clean way to configure Autoloader to fail on schema mismatch instead of silently casting or adapting? Thanks in advance.
answer:
For schema evolution, you can check the supported AutoLoader's schema evolution here: Schema Evolution.

If you want to enforce schema and fail the streaming once new schema or column is detected, set the option cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode to failOnNewColumns .

spark.readStream \
.format("cloudFiles") \
.option("cloudFiles.format", "parquet") \
.option("cloudFiles.schemaEvolutionMode", "failOnNewColumns") \
.load("path") \
.writeStream \
.format("delta") \
.outputMode("append") \
.toTable("tablename")
